The '''person''' lived during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and became a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vandar Tokare]].

==Biography==
The Padawan became one of Tokare's two Padawans, along with [[Derrica Praji]]. In [[4225 BBY]], Tokare, Praji and the other Padawan traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]], where they participated in the [[Kaikieli Reconquista]], a campaign to retake the planet from [[Pirate/Legends|criminals]].
